categories.main_business_segments: WEILONG Delicious Global Holdings Ltd operates primarily in the spicy snack food industry in China, with three main product segments: seasoned flour products (including various types of Latiao and spicy sticks), vegetable products (such as Konjac Shuang, Fengchi Kelp, and XIAO MO NV), and bean-based and other products (including spicy tofu skin). The company integrates R&D, production, and sales, focusing on product innovation and diversification within these categories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group emphasizes industrialized production methods with a focus on automation and quality control. It has in-house developed automated production equipment and systems tailored to its processes, supported by professional electrical control and mechanical design teams. The company employs HACCP for food safety, advanced detection technologies (HPLC-MS, GC-MS, ICP-MS), and maintains a strict quality assurance system covering the entire product lifecycle. It also collaborates with OEM suppliers for lower-volume products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are offline and online distributors, including national and regional supermarkets, snack specialty retailers, chained convenience stores, warehouse membership stores, and emerging e-commerce platforms. The company targets young consumers in China, leveraging omni-channel sales strategies to reach them effectively. Overseas sales are currently minimal but the company is actively exploring international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations and majority of revenue are concentrated in Mainland China, with a nationwide distribution network covering Eastern, Central, Northern, Southern, Southwestern, and Northwestern China. It also has subsidiaries and production facilities primarily in Henan Province and offices in Shanghai and Hong Kong. Overseas operations and revenue are currently limited but expanding, with subsidiaries in Malaysia, Singapore, and other locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: WEILONG operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing (production of snack foods) and distribution through extensive offline and online channels. It manages raw material procurement, production, quality control, and sales, with a strong emphasis on supply chain automation and efficiency to meet market demand.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus is on continuous product innovation, expanding its multi-category product portfolio, and upgrading existing products to meet evolving consumer preferences. It invests in R&D with specialized teams in food science, flavor research, process technology, and packaging. The company also prioritizes digital transformation, automation, data-enabled operations, and supply chain agility to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of snack food products across multiple channels. The company sells to offline distributors, online distributors, and directly to consumers via self-operated online stores on major e-commerce platforms. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of delivery, with some contracts allowing returns and volume rebates. The company also receives government grants as subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: WEILONG is a leading and pioneering brand in China's spicy snack food market, recognized for its innovation and strong brand presence among young consumers. It holds a competitive position by continuously expanding its product range and leveraging omni-channel sales. While specific competitors are not named, the company emphasizes its leadership in product development, quality, and brand vitality within the domestic snack food industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The Group reported revenue of RMB 6.27 billion in 2024, a 28.6% increase from 2023, with a gross profit margin of 48.1%. Net profit grew by 21.3% to RMB 1.07 billion. The company has shown consistent growth in revenue, gross profit, and net profit over recent years, supported by expanding production capacity and sales channels. Total assets reached RMB 8.18 billion with net assets of RMB 6.01 billion as of 2024 year-end.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: WEILONG differentiates itself by transforming authentic Chinese gourmet flavors into casual, convenient, and affordable snack foods that appeal strongly to young consumers. Its value proposition centers on product quality, innovative spicy flavors, diversified product categories, and engaging brand marketing that resonates with youth culture. The company emphasizes industrialized production for consistent quality, a strict food safety system, and a vibrant brand image supported by omni-channel accessibility.
